00046 PauseUGenInternal::PauseUGenInternal(Pause_InputsWithTypesOnly) throw()
00047 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00048     prevLevel(0.f)

00053

00057                                  inputs[Level].getChannel(channel));

00059 
00060 void PauseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00061 {
00062     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00063     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00064     
00065     float currentLevel = *(inputs[Level].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00066     
00067     if(currentLevel == 0.f && prevLevel == 0.f)
00068     {
00069         memset(outputSamples, 0, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00070     }
00071     else
00072     {
00073         float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00074         
00075         if(currentLevel != prevLevel)
00076         {
00077             float inc = (currentLevel - prevLevel) / (float)numSamplesToProcess;
00078             float level = prevLevel;
00079             while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00080             {
00081                 *outputSamples++ = *inputSamples++ * level;
00082                 level += inc;
00083             }
00084         }
00085         else
00086         {
00087             while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00088             {
00089                 *outputSamples++ = *inputSamples++ * currentLevel;
00090             }
00091         }
00092     }
00093     
00094     prevLevel = currentLevel;
00095 }
